title: Boost Recall with Full Lists
description: To remember all items: - Avoid splitting lists: Keep the whole list in view when reviewing. - Use categories: Organize items into groups to make them easier to recall. - Quiz yourself: After reviewing, cover the list and test yourself on all the items. Example: When memorizing a grocery list, don’t focus only on part of it—review the entire list.
